content: DCB spec + dcb.events course-subscriptions example: an AppendCondition must contain failIfEventsMatch query and may contain an 'after' sequence position; stores must fail the append if any event matching the condition exists after the marker. Tags are semantic (subjects involved), not merely indices; a hard constraint that depends on an event requires that event to carry the necessary tag. Course example tags CourseDefined/CapacityChanged with courseId, and StudentSubscribedToCourse with BOTH studentId and courseId so a concurrent subscribe to the same course or by the same student fails the condition.
